faq_records.question: Can I sign a one-way NDA without legal review?
faq_records.answer: Yes, if it uses the approved template unmodified; any redline routes to Tier 3.

faq_records.question: Where do I find the current MSA template?
faq_records.answer: The self-service portal always serves the current approved version; do not use saved local copies.

faq_records.question: What triggers escalated review for a new vendor?
faq_records.answer: Contract value at or above the vendor-intake routing threshold (see LGL-07).

faq_records.question: How fast can I get a COI issued?
faq_records.answer: Tier 1 self-service issues standard COIs within 1 business hour.

faq_records.question: Who can route a document for e-signature?
faq_records.answer: Any employee with an active portal account; routing does not require legal review for approved templates.

faq_records.question: Where is the current policy library?
faq_records.answer: See the internal policy library corpus (CORE-05); the portal links directly to the current version.
